# llm-splitter runtime snapshot

QVAC maintains this local snapshot of llm-splitter 0.2.0. Based on the integrity-pinned upstream npm distribution. Any runtime changes are recorded as exact patches in PROVENANCE.json; all other runtime bytes are unchanged. Original authorship and license notices are retained. CLI binaries, development metadata, tests and source maps are excluded.

The module name and version are retained for compatibility with existing consumers. No upstream repository ownership, new remote repository or npm publication is implied. Update this snapshot through scripts/sync-third-party.mjs and run the runtime contract and installed CLI suites.
